Definition: Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
BiblicalUsage: Manasseh = "causing to forget"; 1) the eldest son of Joseph and progenitor of the tribe of Manasseh; 1a) the tribe descended from Manasseh; 1b) the territory occupied by the tribe of Manasseh; 2) son of king Hezekiah of Judah and himself king of Judah; he was the immediate and direct cause for the exile; 3) a descendant of Pahath-moab who put away a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) a descendant of Hashum who put away a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
